integrity: Finite exhaustive certificate proves the universal formula only through the mathematical reduction of arbitrary supports to fifteen membership-cell count types. Direct small-case enumeration is corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only four-point supports of open neighborhoods in rank-three Johnson graphs; no other polynomial coefficients, ranks, or closed neighborhoods. Earlier local rooted classifications and general VC upper bounds are prior work. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Five hypergraph motifs and the exact maximum-shattering count in rank-three Johnson graphs
